checks: existing requests get a baseline status event without being modified
public tracking by REQ only returns number and general status
unknown, malformed or UUID lookups return a minimal empty response
review start (idempotent) moves to in_review with the validator recorded
approval places the work in Backlog: approved_backlog
leaving Backlog to ANY active phase (ready_to_start) means in_progress
blocking shows blocked publicly and keeps the technical phase
unblocking restores in_progress from the current phase
moving back to Backlog is recorded (regression)
blocked from Backlog returns to approved_backlog
done only when every flow reaches its final phase
block history keeps reason, responsible and dates after completion
full server-side transition and phase history recorded
rejection path: rejected, no backlog, no reason exposed publicly
per-client rate limit blocks enumeration bursts without affecting others
